H100 in-prepare: pooler m=128 k2x 28.58 vs 28.90; qkv m=128 rsk2x 20.67 vs 20.54; pooler m=256 n128x (the same pipeline on a 64x128 tile) 31.74 vs 34.11.
target_shapes: pooler m=128: k2x within 0.5 us of torch (cuBLAS)
qkv_gate m=128: k2x / rsk2x within 0.5 us of torch
pooler m=256: n128x at least 1.0 us under torch
